entries.title: Titus 3:1
segments: Put them in mind to be in subjection to rulers, to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready unto every good work,

entries.title: Titus 3:2
segments: to speak evil of no man, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all meekness toward all men.

entries.title: Titus 3:3
segments: For we also once were foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, hating one another.

entries.title: Titus 3:4
segments: But when the kindness of God our Saviour, and his love toward man, appeared,

entries.title: Titus 3:5
segments: not by works [done] in righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,

entries.title: Titus 3:6
segments: which he poured out upon us richly, through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

entries.title: Titus 3:7
segments: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

entries.title: Titus 3:8
segments: Faithful is the saying, and concerning these things I desire that thou affirm confidently, to the end that they who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men:

entries.title: Titus 3:9
segments: but shun foolish questionings, and genealogies, and strifes, and fightings about law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

entries.title: Titus 3:10
segments: A factious man after a first and second admonition refuse;

entries.title: Titus 3:11
segments: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sinneth, being self-condemned.

entries.title: Titus 3:12
segments: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, give diligence to come unto me to Nicopolis: for there I have determined to winter.

entries.title: Titus 3:13
segments: Set forward Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

entries.title: Titus 3:14
segments: And let our [people] also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

entries.title: Titus 3:15
segments: All that are with me salute thee. Salute them that love us in faith. Grace be with you all.
